message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport (IATA) | City / State | Notable Features |
|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL)** | Atlanta, GA | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** | Los Angeles, CA | Key gateway to Asia and Latin America; major hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD)** | Chicago, IL | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)** | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the largest single-runway airports. |
| **Denver International Airport (DEN)** | Denver, CO | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United Airlines and Southwest. |
| **John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)** | New York City, NY | Primary hub for United Airlines and American Airlines; major international gateway. |
| **San Francisco International Airport (SFO)** | San Francisco, CA | Hub for United Airlines and a major gateway to Asia. |
| **Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA)** | Seattle, WA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| **Miami International Airport (MIA)** | Miami, FL | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| **Orlando International Airport (MCO)** | Orlando, FL | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; high volume of leisure travelers. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)** | Phoenix, AZ | Hub for American Airlines; high domestic traffic. |
| **George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)** | Houston, TX | Major hub for United Airlines; significant cargo operations. |
| **Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT)** | Charlotte, NC | Hub for American Airlines; growing international traffic. |
| **McCarran International Airport (LAS)** | Las Vegas, NV | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; high leisure traffic. |
| **Boston Logan International Airport (BOS)** | Boston, MA | Hub for JetBlue Airways; important for Northeast Corridor travel. |

These airports serve as major hubs for airlines, handle large volumes of passengers, and often have extensive international connections.
